title: VXAce How to move title screen text box + make text boxes opaque?

posts.author: Snowi_Husky
posts.body:
I'm trying to make a game, and I really want to learn how to move the text box to be as shown here
(Adjustment not as accurate; but just something along the lines of moving the text box to the right.)
That way I have more room to do the title screen art.
I also have the problem with making the background text box opaque. I tried to do it myself in an attempt to sort of learn but I just don't understand a bunch of the code and how it works.

posts.author: Chiispiitas
posts.body:
Open your Script Editor (F11 key) and look for Window_TitleCommand.
You can change the window placement here on line 24:
Ruby:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Update Window Position
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_placement
    self.x = (Graphics.width - width) / 2
    self.y = (Graphics.height * 1.6 - height) / 2
  end
As you can see, there are some formulas, but they're safe to remove and you can just specify your own X,Y coordinates. Try something like this and adjust the numbers to achieve the result you'd like:
Ruby:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Update Window Position
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def update_placement
    self.x = 360
    self.y = 280
  end

posts.author: Snowi_Husky
posts.body: This is perfect! Thank you so much!

posts.author: Solita
posts.body:
There's a bunch of scripts you can use for custom titles, if you want to have more custom designs like the transparent box, you mentioned, here
https://mogplugins.com/rpg-maker-vx-ace/
There's also this script to allow more options -
https://gdu.one/scripts/rpg-maker-vx-ace/v-s-awesome-options/
If you don't want to use them, you can use this script for the transparent window.
Ruby:
class Scene_Title < Scene_Base
  alias :title_create_command_window_base :create_command_window
  def create_command_window
    title_create_command_window_base
    @command_window.opacity = 0
  end
end
